To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) BODs can be effectively used to specify and exchange business objects and business operations among heterogeneous application systems, (ii) the BODs and their associated business rules can be modeled as active object models and the models can be automatically used to generate entity and converter classes in Java for validating data transferred between business objects and for mediating data to meet the constraints of both the source system and target system, and (iii) the entity and converter classes can be used as platform-independent adapters

we have developed an active object model for BODs, and have used it to generate Java classes and software components for data validation and mediation, which can be used to integrate heterogeneous application systems in a virtual enterprise.
the BODs can be used to specify business operations and to transfer data between heterogeneous application systems.

the specification of BODs, their validation and mediation, and their integration with heterogeneous application systems.

the specification of BODs and their use for inter-operating heterogeneous application systems.
